statement: AMD claims ROCm 10 delivers an average 3.3x inference improvement and 2.4x training improvement versus ROCm 7, benchmarked on AMD Instinct MI355X systems.
why: Software gains on installed MI355X hardware raise the useful work per dollar of already-purchased silicon, which is the main lever AMD has to close the practical gap with the incumbent stack.

impact.mechanism: Higher throughput per installed GPU improves effective compute per dollar and makes the non-incumbent GPU line more competitive on cost per token.

confidence.basis: Vendor-published benchmark claim in a secondary-tier announcement, with no independent verification and no named customer deployment.
